EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for contacting support!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello Customer,
Thank you for contacting our Service Team at Volvo Financial Services. Your case number is: {!Case.CaseNumber} : {!Case.Subject} We will aim to respond to your enquiry within 48 working hours.
Please note our opening hours are 08:30h – 16:30h Monday to Friday (excluding bank holidays).
We are happy to invite you to register your details to be able to start using My Account by Renault Financial Services.
My Account will give you access to your Renault Financial Services agreements, enabling you to view your invoices and contract information with additional features coming soon!
Click here to join My Account by Renault Financial Services..
Thanks,
Service Team
